title: JFrog Business Value Center: Celebrate the ROI of Your Software Supply Chain
summary: Discover the ROI of development operations with JFrog Business Value Center's real-time metrics of developer hours saved and downtime avoided.
body_markdown:
You already know the effectiveness of the[JFrog Platform](https://jfrog.com/platform/) – blocking risky packages, speeding up builds, securing the supply chain, providing end-to-end governance and so much more. But when it comes time to renew the license, a new VP may ask: “What are we actually getting in return?” or finance wants to understand the ROI: can it really be proven by the numbers? For most teams the proof lives in catastrophes narrowly averted, scattered logs and half-remembered wins, not a definitive report you can share with your team.


The new **JFrog Business Value Center** closes that gap, by providing a value based dashboard inside[MyJFrog](https://jfrog.com/blog/myjfrog-central-management-portal/) . Acting as an account portal – it turns development logs into clear business metrics: the ROI you’re earning, how much of your software supply chain you’re protecting, and how heavily your teams rely on it. No spreadsheets, no estimates. This post covers what the dashboard provides, why it matters, and how it can help increase the efficiency of your software development operations.


**Key Takeaway:** The immense value of your software supply chain platform has always been there. Now, the **JFrog Business Value Center** makes that impact measurable and visible. By calculating real-time ROI, security coverage, and usage insights, it helps you share your team’s successes, demonstrate security leadership, and present the results to budgetary and executive reviews with clear, auditable proof of value.


## Why is it challenging to prove the value of a software supply chain platform?


DevOps and security teams achieve remarkable results every day, but sharing that impact across the broader organization can present unique challenges:


- **Champion turnover resets the story.** The person who first championed JFrog moves on and their successor inherits a contract with no context of why it matters and the benefits for development operations.


- **ROI rests on estimates, not actual results.** Teams know that builds are faster and vulnerabilities are down, but can’t produce specific data demonstrating productivity gains, risks avoided, or costs saved. Unfortunately, this results in a business case that leans more on guesswork than actual numbers.


- **The data is locked inside operations.** The proof of value already exists in build logs, scan results, and repository activity, but getting it out and into a readable format takes manual effort that most teams don’t have time for.


Each gap has the same root: the platform produces real value every day, but that value remains invisible if the benefits can’t be presented in clear business terms.


## What is the JFrog Business Value Center?


The JFrog Business Value Center presents key metrics inside MyJFrog that quantify what the JFrog Platform delivers in terms of: ROI, efficiency, and usage, while keeping data updated in real time.


Instead of asking your team to reconstruct the value story once a year, the JFrog Business Value Center has it ready for you on-demand. At a glance, teams can see cost saved through risk reduction, developer hours reclaimed and storage avoided. In addition it shows which parts of the supply chain are actively being scanned for vulnerabilities, and how extensively teams depend on the platform for day to day operations.


For example, the JFrog Business Value Center can provide data showing how hundreds of thousands of dollars were saved, thousands of developer hours were reclaimed, and the percentage of repositories currently being scanned. These are the kind of figures that can be used to build a strong business case.


*The JFrog Business Value Center provides real-time updates and proof of ROI for devlopment operations*


## What does the JFrog Business Value Center measure?


The JFrog Business Value Center measures two groups of metrics: Optimization and ROI, each expressed as an actionable value.


1. **Optimization: How fast and protected are your software development operations?**
This information includes how much of your software supply chain is being actively scanned for vulnerabilities by[JFrog Xray](https://jfrog.com/xray/) , and the share of incoming open-source packages blocked from reaching developers according to your policies screened against your policies before they reach developers.
2. **ROI: How much time and money are you saving with your Software Supply Chain Platform?**
Data includes developer hours spent on coding instead of fixing vulnerabilities, based on[JFrog Curation’s](https://jfrog.com/curation/) screening and blocking of open-source packages before it can reach your development environment. This information is also used to calculate savings based on avoiding exposure due to stopping risky packages before they reach production and storage capacity that was never provisioned due to deduplication of identical binaries.


Taken together, these metrics turn “we think it’s working” into “here is exactly how our platform is providing value.”


And this is only the beginning. More metrics are on their way and will be added to the JFrog Business Value Center in the coming months.


## Why proving software supply chain value matters now?


Several major shifts in software development operations have made demonstrating software supply chain value urgent rather than nice-to-have, including:


- **Security is now a board-level line item.** High-profile software supply chain attacks have made “how much of our estate is actually protected?” a question leadership asks directly and expects a numerical value – not just reassurance.


- **AI has introduced fast-moving new risks.** Models, datasets, and agents are entering pipelines faster than most teams can govern them, and shadow AI is a genuine exposure. Being able to show what’s under governance, and what isn’t, is quickly becoming a baseline expectation.


- **Budgets face harder scrutiny.** With usage-based consumption and tighter software spending, every renewal and expansion needs to demonstrate their ROI. “Trust us, it’s working” no longer survives a finance review.


The value was always there. What’s changed is that security, finance, and leadership now all want the numbers behind it, on demand.


## Why the JFrog Business Value Center matters for JFrog customers


The JFrog Business Value Center helps transform the JFrog Platform from another software solution into an asset with significant return on investment . Now you can enter every meeting with the confidence to:


- **Justify spend with the actual numbers.** Walk into a renewal or budget review with ROI, hours saved, and risk avoided already quantified for you.


- **Prove your security posture.** Show, in one view, how much of your supply chain is scanned and curated and where your AI governance stands.


- **Survive champion turnover.** New stakeholders see the value story immediately instead of starting from zero.


- **Get the most out of the JFrog Platform.** When the data shows how embedded and effective the platform is, the conversation about doing more with JFrog gets easier.


For the DevOps, SRE, and platform leaders who own the renewal, that’s the difference between defending a line item and championing a strategic investment.


## How do you get started with the JFrog Business Value Center?


If you’re a JFrog SaaS customer, it’s already part of MyJFrog. All you need to do is sign into[MyJFrog](https://my.jfrog.com/) to see your platform’s value in real numbers. After that, you can take those figures into your next renewal meeting, budget review, or leadership update. As mentioned, this is only the first version of the JFrog Business Value Center. Expect to see additional metrics added to the Business Value Center soon.


Take it to the next level by[scheduling a consultation with our team](https://jfrog.com/contact-sales/) about how to map the data from the JFrog Business Value Center to your ROI and security goals.
